Are you creative enough to source parts that almost no one else can find?

As a warehouse employee at Zara in the center of Utrecht, you work part-time in a logistics team. You work 3 to 8 hours per week and can choose between morning or evening shifts. This job is perfect if you want to combine it with your studies or another job. With a salary of €14.99 per hour, you start strong right away.
Your day starts with unpacking deliveries. You sort clothing and accessories and place them in the correct location in the warehouse. You make sure the store always has enough stock. After your shift, you help to keep the warehouse tidy. Together with your colleagues, you ensure smooth logistics and a pleasant work atmosphere.
This job is ideal if you want flexible work and like to stay active. Experience is not required; your motivation counts. Apply quickly and make a difference in the center of Utrecht! ✨

- At least VMBO (secondary education) working and thinking level

- Experience is not required, but is a plus

- Able to work independently and in a team

- Physically fit and proactive
